column29: If the Claim Cost exceeds the Outlier Threshold, then the claim qualifies for a DRG outlier add-on payment. The Outlier Threshold is calculated as: Outlier Threshold = Unadjusted DRG Base Payment + Fixed Loss Amount. The Fixed Loss Amount is $5,000 for Critical Access Hospitals (CAH) and $65,000 for all other providers. For claims that qualify, the Unadjusted DRG Outlier Add-on Payment will be calculated as: Unadjusted DRG Outlier Add-on Payment = [Claim Cost – Outlier Threshold] * DRG Marginal Cost Percentage. The DRG Marginal Cost Percentage is 90% for burn DRGs and 80% for all other DRGs. Additionally, qualifying administrative days are paid at per diems when billed separately from acute services.

column21: Case rate for 24 days. Days 25+ paid at $4,264 Med/Surg per diem or $6,136 ICU/CCU per diem. If a patient receives a VAD/TAH prior to transplant, payment for VAD/TAH is $18,200 case rate on implant date, and $7,800 per diem starting day 2+ until discharge or transplant. Related services during pre implant or post implant phases are paid at 65% for inpatient services and 60% of outpatient services. column21: Case rate applicable for 25 allowable days. Days 26-90 paid at per diem of $4,627 for non-ICU days and $6,480 for ICU days. If billed charges exceed 375% of the case rate, reimbursement will be 65% of charges for charges above the threshold. High cost drugs in revenue code 343, 344, 636 that have billed charges greater than $5,000 per revenue code will be paid at 50% of charges. VAD/TAH used as a bridge to transplant are reimbursed $87,903 for the day of implant. Additional inpatient days will be reimbursed at $4,564 non-ICU per diem and $5,707 ICU per diem, but no less than 52% of charges. Outpatient charges will be reimbursed at 45% of charges for VAD/TAH.
